name: lv_obj_set_scroll_snap_y

ownership.argument: borrows a live LVGL object; vertical scroll snap mode

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-10-pro-3.101.043 image/IDB: Sets the 2-bit scroll_snap_y field of spec_attr. Located by its field layout in the LVGL v9.0 lv_obj_spec_attr_t and by the firmware's own Lua binding of the same method.

notes: Static recovery only; Mirage is emulator evidence. UI owner thread only. The object must be a live LVGL object created on this page.
